highlights.title: District 1 street food
highlights.summary: Pavement kitchens, banh mi carts and night markets packed into a few walkable blocks.
highlights.transfer: 25–40 minutes from Tan Son Nhat depending on traffic; the centre is walkable once you arrive.

highlights.title: Cu Chi Tunnels
highlights.summary: The wartime tunnel network north-west of the city, seen on a guided walk-through.
highlights.transfer: About 1.5–2 hours from the centre by road, commonly done as a half-day trip.

image.licenseNote: Public domain — no attribution required. Kevyn Jacobs credited voluntarily. Downloaded 2026-09-12 from Wikimedia Commons at 800px.

highlights.title: Vung Tau
highlights.summary: The closest stretch of coast to the city, with Back Beach, seafood stalls and a hilltop Christ statue.
highlights.transfer: About 2 hours from the centre by road.
